# TaxPreparers

> TaxPreparers is a registered tax agent practice with offices in Mill Park and Doreen, in Melbourne's north (Victoria, Australia). "We Prepare | You Save."

TaxPreparers is registered with the Tax Practitioners board (tax agent number 25492655) to provide Taxation Services to individuals and businesses, and is an ASIC registered agent.

## Services

- Individual, partnership, company and trust tax returns
- Self managed super fund (SMSF) tax returns
- Business Activity Statements (BAS) and GST
- Book-keeping
- ASIC secretarial services: company formation, changes to company details, business name, ABN, TFN and GST registrations
- Business consulting and due diligence

## Prices

- Tax returns from $120
- Capital gains advice and estate planning
